For each full 1715x8575 saved distance matrix, exactly 42875 same-ID/same-camera query-gallery pairs are removed. All 1715 queries have valid positives; six metrics, CMC1..50 and identity/camera/scene groups reconcile.
AP averages precision at relevant ranks; INP is relevant-count/last-relevant-rank. Reported percentages divide sums by the valid query count, not prediction maxima, minima or means.
Feature L2 normalization is part of retrieval distance construction and is not post-hoc metric rescaling. Full 5120D feature norms lie within 1.23e-7 of one.

Fresh cached-distance reductions agree with reported raw six metrics to numerical summation precision. Reconstructing distances from saved features has separately disclosed float32 arithmetic differences.

Both terminal runs and all six native/training/audit child exit records are present and consistent. Detached controller is recorded COMPLETE and absent at the terminal observation; its OS exit code is not attested.

All 100 epoch JSON/CSV exports and curves were reconciled, including 171500 epoch query rows. Selected raw arrays were independently recounted; checkpoint tensors were decoded without importing Torch.
Earliest benchmark mAP-best selection is E24 for head8 and E16 for head32; all six metrics, best.json, recorded strict reload and selected exports belong to that same checkpoint.

The admitted wrapper calls run_full_official_experiment.main, whose per-epoch evaluate calls full_metrics and whose final strict reload repeats full query/gallery evaluation. There are 50 EPOCH log entries plus one terminal completion per run, corresponding exported metrics and successful audit child exits.
mAP, mINP, Rank-1/5/10/20, CMC50, and groups all have actual output and independently checked consumers.

Legacy dev-split and missing49 command-line mains in imported utility files were not invoked by this normal-input runner; their existence does not imply this task evaluated dev holdouts or missing modalities.
One dataset, normal three-modality input, one seed42, two new existing-DeMo head configurations and 50 epochs each. Six native updates are engineering checks, separate from 6270 formal updates.
Both epochs and the selected head configuration use this benchmark. These are selected single-run results, not an untouched final test or multiseed evidence.

Only the new B128 head8/head32 pair is freshly matched for the head setting, seed, batch composition, sampled record order and attempted update budget. Head count also changes parameter count by172032.

Historical original/B64 head32 use B64/K16/P4 and6357 updates, versus B128/K16/P8 and3135 updates. AV adds an expert50 stage to the original50 teacher (6563 expert updates); five-row comparisons are diagnostic, not uniformly single-factor or equal-total-compute.
Cumulative forward and successful-update coverage both reach8675 records, but identity sampling does not consume every record in every epoch.

Both new baselines remain below the required paper-relative87.2mAP/98.6Rank-1. Head8 is the better selected baseline among these two, not evidence for dual-axis/Ours contribution. No new missing49/paper6, robustness or multiseed claims are supported.
Dataset identity/camera labels determine retrieval relevance and junk exclusion. No model-produced pseudo-ground-truth, self-supervised proxy, simulation or human rating is used.
This fresh audit is an independent deterministic replay of cached distances/features and a tensor-file inspection. It is not independent network inference from the selected weights.
